About these 30 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Thursday and Saturday have the most, 8 each. The earliest start is Bike Roswell! Saturday Morning Ride at 8:00 am; the latest is Midweek Roll at 7:30 pm. After work, 21 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 7 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 8. There’s one ride made for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.

I’d like to say I ride for everyone else. I ride because it changed me.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
